_comment: Map raw controller inputs to actions. Action strings are listed in the README. Button/axis numbers may differ per unit - run the script and use the diagnostic mode (it prints which button index you press) to confirm, then edit the numbers here.

_available_buttons._comment: Reference only, not read by the script. Standard SDL/pygame CONTROLLER_BUTTON_* index -> name, confirmed against this controller's working config below.

_available_actions._comment: Reference only, not read by the script. 'wired' = already implemented in KEY_ACTIONS (controller_remote.py) and usable now. 'available' = supported by pynput.keyboard.Key but not yet added to KEY_ACTIONS - add an entry there to use one.
